requirement: The lawnmower shall contain engine, blade, deck, frontLeftWheel, frontRightWheel, rearLeftWheel, rearRightWheel, and handle parts.
The lawnmower shall connect engine to deck.
The lawnmower shall connect engine to blade.
The lawnmower shall connect deck to frontLeftWheel.
The lawnmower shall connect deck to frontRightWheel.
The lawnmower shall connect deck to rearLeftWheel.
The lawnmower shall connect deck to rearRightWheel.
The lawnmower shall connect deck to handle.
The Engine shall contain piston, connectingRod, crankshaft, crankshaftBearing, and engineBlock parts.
The Engine shall connect piston.pistonPort to connectingRod.connectingRodPort.
The Engine shall connect connectingRod.connectingRodCrankPort to crankshaft.crankshaftPort.
The Engine shall connect crankshaft.crankshaftBearingPort to crankshaftBearing.bearingPort.
The Engine shall connect crankshaftBearing.bearingBlockPort to engineBlock.engineBlockPort.
The Engine shall connect engineBlock.cylinderPort to piston.cylinderPort.
The piston part shall have an output port pistonPort typed by ForcePort.
The piston part shall have an input port cylinderPort typed by ForcePort.
The connectingRod part shall have an input port connectingRodPort typed by ForcePort.
The connectingRod part shall have an output port connectingRodCrankPort typed by ForcePort.
The crankshaft part shall have an input port crankshaftPort typed by ForcePort.
The crankshaft part shall have an output port crankshaftBearingPort typed by ForcePort.
The crankshaftBearing part shall have an input port bearingPort typed by ForcePort.
The crankshaftBearing part shall have an output port bearingBlockPort typed by ForcePort.
The engineBlock part shall have an input port engineBlockPort typed by ForcePort.
The engineBlock part shall have an output port cylinderPort typed by ForcePort.
The Wheel shall contain rim and tire parts.
